```{r}


set.seed(123)

library(ggplot2)

# Simulation parameters
n_sim <- 200
alpha <- 0.05
p0 <- 0.9
p1_values <- seq(0.85, 0.5, by = -0.05)

# Grid of scenarios
row_counts <- c(5, 10, 20)  # number of rows per group
trial_scenarios <- list(
    "Low variability" = 5:15,       # all rows 5 trials
    "Moderate variability" = 1:30,
    "High variability" = 1:50
)

# Function to generate variable trials per scenario
generate_trials <- function(scenario, n_rows) {
    vals <- trial_scenarios[[scenario]]
    sample(vals, n_rows, replace = TRUE)
}

# Simulate one dataset
simulate_once <- function(p1, trials_row) {
    n_rows <- length(trials_row)
    
    successes0 <- rbinom(n_rows, trials_row, p0)
    successes1 <- rbinom(n_rows, trials_row, p1)
    
    dat <- data.frame(
        group = factor(rep(c(0,1), each = n_rows)),
        successes = c(successes0, successes1),
        trials = c(trials_row, trials_row)
    )
    
    # Binomial GLM
    glm_fit <- glm(cbind(successes, trials - successes) ~ group,
                   family = binomial, data = dat)
    p_glm <- summary(glm_fit)$coefficients["group1","Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    # T-test on proportions
    dat$prop <- dat$successes / dat$trials

   t_pval <- tryCatch(
  t.test(prop ~ group, data = dat)$p.value,
  error = function(e) 1  # if t-test fails (no variance), record p=1
)
    
    c(p_glm = p_glm, t_pval = t_pval)
}

# Run simulations across all combinations
results_list <- list()
for(n_rows in row_counts) {
    for(scenario in names(trial_scenarios)) {
        cat("Simulating n_rows =", n_rows, ", scenario =", scenario, "\n")
        for(p1 in p1_values) {
            glm_significant <- numeric(n_sim)
            t_significant <- numeric(n_sim)
            
            for(i in 1:n_sim) {
                trials_row <- generate_trials(scenario, n_rows)
                sim_res <- simulate_once(p1, trials_row)
                glm_significant[i] <- sim_res["p_glm"] < alpha
                t_significant[i] <- sim_res["t_pval"] < alpha
            }
            
            results_list[[length(results_list)+1]] <- data.frame(
                p1 = p1,
                method = c("binomial GLM", "t-test on proportions"),
                power = c(mean(glm_significant), mean(t_significant)),
                scenario = scenario,
                n_rows = n_rows
            )
        }
    }
}

# Combine results
power_df <- do.call(rbind, results_list)

power_df$scenario <- factor(power_df$scenario,
                            levels = c("Low variability", "Moderate variability", "High variability"))

# Plot power curves faceted by number of rows, colored by method, separate panels for trial variability
ggplot(power_df, aes(x = p1, y = power, color = method)) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    facet_grid(scenario ~ n_rows, labeller = labeller(
        scenario = label_value,
        n_rows = function(x) paste("Rows per group =", x)
    )) +
    labs(
        title = "Power Curves: Binomial GLM vs t-test on proportions",
        subtitle = "Effect of trial heterogeneity and number of rows per group",
        x = "True success probability in group 1",
        y = "Estimated Power",
        color = "Method"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray40") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("binomial GLM" = "red", "t-test on proportions" = "blue")) +
    ylim(0,1)



```

```{r}
# --- Demonstration: t-test/linear model vs binomial GLM ---
# Shows how emmeans reveals impossible CI (>1) from linear model on proportions

set.seed(123)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(emmeans)

# --- Parameters ---
n_sim <- 200
n_rows <- 15
trial_range <- 5:30
p0 <- 0.95
p1 <- 0.80
alpha <- 0.05

# --- One simulation: fit both models and extract EMMs on response scale ---
simulate_one <- function() {
  # Random trial counts
  trials_row <- sample(trial_range, n_rows, replace = TRUE)
  successes0 <- rbinom(n_rows, trials_row, p0)
  successes1 <- rbinom(n_rows, trials_row, p1)
  
  dat <- data.frame(
    group = factor(rep(c("control","treat"), each = n_rows)),
    successes = c(successes0, successes1),
    trials = c(trials_row, trials_row)
  )
  dat$prop <- dat$successes / dat$trials
  
  # Linear model on proportions (wrong model)
  fit_lm <- lm(prop ~ group, data = dat)
  em_lm <- as.data.frame(emmeans(fit_lm, ~ group, type = "response"))
  em_lm$model <- "lm_proportion"
  
  # Binomial GLM (correct model)
  fit_glm <- glm(cbind(successes, trials - successes) ~ group,
                 family = binomial, data = dat)
  em_glm <- as.data.frame(emmeans(fit_glm, ~ group, type = "response"))
  em_glm <- em_glm |> rename(emmean = prob, lower.CL = asymp.LCL, upper.CL = asymp.UCL)
  em_glm$model <- "glm_binomial"
  
  bind_rows(em_lm, em_glm)
}

# --- Run simulations ---
res_list <- replicate(n_sim, simulate_one(), simplify = FALSE)
emm_df <- bind_rows(res_list, .id = "sim") %>%
  mutate(sim = as.integer(sim))

# --- Flag impossible CIs ---
emm_df <- emm_df %>%
  mutate(ci_below0 = lower.CL < 0,
         ci_above1 = upper.CL > 1)

# --- Summarize how often CIs violate bounds ---
violation_summary <- emm_df %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(
    prop_below0 = mean(ci_below0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_above1 = mean(ci_above1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(violation_summary)

# --- Plot: estimated means with 95% CI for subset of sims ---
plot_df <- emm_df %>%
  filter(sim <= 200)  # show first 200 simulations for clarity

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = sim, y = emmean, color = model)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
                  alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, nrow = 2, scales = "fixed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0, 1), linetype = "dotted", color = "gray40") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("lm_proportion" = "blue", "glm_binomial" = "red"),
    labels = c("Linear model on proportions", "Binomial GLM")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Estimated Means and 95% CI from Linear Model vs Binomial GLM",
    subtitle = "CIs from LM (blue) can exceed 1; Binomial GLM (red) stays within [0,1]",
    x = "Simulation index",
    y = "Estimated group mean (response scale)",
    color = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.75,1.03))
```


```{r}
# Simulation: compare pooled glm (LRT), t-test on proportions, and GLMM (LRT)
# Vary between-replicate SD (sigma_rep) and number of replicates (n_reps)

# ------------------------------
# Simulation: GLM vs t-test vs GLMM
# ------------------------------

# ------------------------------
# Simulation: GLM vs t-test vs GLMM
# ------------------------------

set.seed(123)
library(lme4)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# ---- Simulation parameters ----
n_sim <- 100                       # simulations per scenario
alpha <- 0.05

# Data structure
n_rows_per_rep_per_group <- 5      # rows per group per replicate
n_trials_per_row <- 10              # trials per row

# Fixed effects (logit scale)
p0 <- 0.2
logit <- function(p) log(p/(1-p))
inv_logit <- function(x) plogis(x)
beta0 <- logit(p0)
OR <- 1.8
beta_trt <- log(OR)

# Sweep parameters
n_reps_vals    <- c(3, 5, 10)              # number of replicate experiments
sigma_rep_vals <- c(0.0,0.5, 1.0,2.0,3.0)   # between-replicate SD on logit scale

# ---- Helper: simulate one experiment ----
simulate_one <- function(n_reps, sigma_rep) {
  res <- c(p_glm = NA, p_t = NA, p_glmm = NA)  # initialize return

  # replicate-specific random intercepts
  u_rep <- rnorm(n_reps, 0, sigma_rep)

  # build dataset
  dat_list <- lapply(seq_len(n_reps), function(r) {
    n <- n_rows_per_rep_per_group
    intercept_r <- beta0 + u_rep[r]

    p_ctrl <- inv_logit(intercept_r)
    p_trt  <- inv_logit(intercept_r + beta_trt)

    s_ctrl <- rbinom(n, n_trials_per_row, p_ctrl)
    s_trt  <- rbinom(n, n_trials_per_row, p_trt)

    data.frame(
      replicate = r,
      group = factor(rep(c("control", "treat"), each = n)),
      successes = c(s_ctrl, s_trt),
      trials = rep(n_trials_per_row, 2*n)
    )
  })
  dat <- bind_rows(dat_list)

  # --- pooled GLM (LRT) ---
  gl <- tryCatch(glm(cbind(successes, trials - successes) ~ group,
                     family = binomial, data = dat),
                 error = function(e) NULL)
  if(!is.null(gl)) {
    nullm <- tryCatch(update(gl, . ~ . - group), error = function(e) NULL)
    if(!is.null(nullm)) {
      an <- tryCatch(anova(nullm, gl, test = "Chisq"), error = function(e) NULL)
      if(!is.null(an) && nrow(an) >= 2 && length(an$`Pr(>Chi)`[2]) == 1) {
   res["p_glm"] <- tryCatch({
  nullm <- update(gl, . ~ . - group)
  an <- anova(nullm, gl, test = "Chisq")
  pval <- an$`Pr(>Chi)`[2]
  if(is.na(pval) || length(pval) != 1) 1 else pval
}, error = function(e) 1)
      }
    }
  }

  # --- t-test on proportions (ignore replicates) ---
  dat$prop <- dat$successes / dat$trials
  res["p_t"] <- tryCatch(t.test(prop ~ group, data = dat)$p.value,
                         error = function(e) 1)

  # --- mixed GLMM (LRT) ---
  glmm <- tryCatch(glmer(cbind(successes, trials - successes) ~ group + (1 | replicate),
                         data = dat, family = binomial,
                         control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                                optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5))),
                   error = function(e) NULL)
  if(!is.null(glmm)) {
    nullm2 <- tryCatch(update(glmm, . ~ . - group), error = function(e) NULL)
    if(!is.null(nullm2)) {
      an2 <- tryCatch(anova(nullm2, glmm, test = "Chisq"), error = function(e) NULL)
      if(!is.null(an2) && nrow(an2) >= 2 && length(an2$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]) == 1) {
        res["p_glmm"] <- an2$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
      }
    }
  }

  return(res)
}

# ---- Run grid of scenarios ----
results <- expand.grid(n_reps = n_reps_vals, sigma_rep = sigma_rep_vals,
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(power_glm  = NA_real_,
         power_t    = NA_real_,
         power_glmm = NA_real_)

for(i in seq_len(nrow(results))) {
  n_reps <- results$n_reps[i]
  sigma_rep <- results$sigma_rep[i]
  cat("Running scenario", i, "of", nrow(results), ": n_reps =", n_reps,
      ", sigma_rep =", sigma_rep, "\n")

  # replicate simulations and ensure matrix output
  pvals <- replicate(n_sim, simulate_one(n_reps, sigma_rep), simplify = "matrix")

  # compute power, ignoring NAs
  results$power_glm[i]  <- mean(pvals["p_glm", ]  < alpha, na.rm = TRUE)
  results$power_t[i]    <- mean(pvals["p_t", ]    < alpha, na.rm = TRUE)
  results$power_glmm[i] <- mean(pvals["p_glmm", ] < alpha, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# ---- Tidy results for plotting ----
plot_df <- results %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("power_"),
               names_to = "method", values_to = "power") %>%
  mutate(method = recode(method,
                         "power_glm"  = "pooled_GLM_LRT",
                         "power_t"    = "t_test_prop",
                         "power_glmm" = "mixed_GLMM_LRT"),
         n_reps = factor(n_reps))

# ---- Plot ----
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = sigma_rep, y = power, color = method, group = method)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ n_reps, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("pooled_GLM_LRT" = "#D55E00",
                                "t_test_prop"  = "#0072B2",
                                "mixed_GLMM_LRT" = "#009E73")) +
  labs(title = "Power vs Between-Replicate SD",
       subtitle = paste0("n_rows_per_rep_per_group = ", n_rows_per_rep_per_group,
                         ", trials_per_row = ", n_trials_per_row,
                         ", sims per cell = ", n_sim),
       x = "Between-replicate SD (logit scale)",
       y = "Estimated power (proportion p < 0.05)",
       color = "Method") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)


```
